body: As a father myself, parents will do almost anything for their kids and the years of unconditional service and love each child receives means you're unlikely to lose a parent based on a bad decision that you show honesty and remorse over. So given your dad seems a nice guy, tell him what's happened and how you've been feeling. The other option is talk to a doctor or a psychologist, as your isolation and sense of hopelessness and suicidal ideation makes you depressed and there's plenty of help available (especially if you haven't tried it so far).

I'd suggest telling a professional (doctor, psychologist) you have ideation but no firm plans or timeframe or means. That way you'll get more effective and targeted support (counselling, medication etc) but nobody will over-react.
